title: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue!/Pizza Planet Tokens
text:
In each level except boss levels there are five Pizza Planet Tokens. There are no tokens in boss levels. 

Each of the five tokens fit into one of the following categories:

 Collect 50 coins and give them to Hamm
 Find 5 toys and bring them to a character in the level
 Complete a task under a timed limit or win a race 
 Complete a task which usually involves finding a hard to reach area or solving a puzzle
 Defeat a boss
